plan.hypothesis: With the single image producer held fixed, persist a seeded CPU RNG across weighted Gaussian sampling calls. Verify the sampler on identical weights and then measure remaining full-training variation.
plan.change: Thread RNG versus trainer-owned StdRng seeded from the CLI seed; no sorting of the refinement HashSet and no change to GPU kernels or other parameters.
plan.scope: Experimental binary only, both modes use the same instrumented build and single image producer. Official engine and application remain unchanged.
plan.acceptance: Separate identical-weight sampler repeatability, consumed-image order, and whole-model repeatability. No general quality/speed claim from two repeats. Keep official engine unless evidence justifies a production change.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.
decision: Keep as an experiment. Sampler tests repeat on identical weights and seed, but full models do not. All four runs per scene have the same point-ID set and image order, yet different initialization key order and first sampling weights. Do not attribute score differences solely to the seeded sampler; fix initialization order before drawing that conclusion.

pilot.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

validation.initial_point_order_observer: Unmodified std::HashMap key traversal before the existing values traversal; no sorting or point changes.
validation.browser: Both variants loaded for each scene; both candidates dragged in walk mode; no console warnings/errors. Thin pipes, cables and areas outside capture coverage remain blurred or streaked.
